title: Pit Sandbox
description: Pit Sandbox - make your own custom enchant combinations, level up by killing bots and players, and fight over the best gear!
body: harrys.gg boasts a variety of unique persistent gamemodes. The largest is Pit Sandbox - make your own custom enchant combinations, level up by killing bots, bosses and players, unlock and upgrade new equipment, and battle to become the most feared fighter. The gamemode is FFA and encourages social play. Join with the IP harrys.gg!
